final_pipeline_notes.selection: Whisper Base English on both platforms; measured subset supports improved quiet-speech retention versus tested Moonshine defaults with lower resource use than Whisper Small.
final_pipeline_notes.chunks: Contiguous bounded 30-second PCM windows, pause-aware boundary selection, no VAD sample discarding; zero-only audio may be skipped.
final_pipeline_notes.blank_rule: Segments with true first-SOT no-speech probability above 0.6 are omitted. No caption or punctuation string filtering.
final_pipeline_notes.ios: WhisperKit Base CoreML; corrected no-speech probability and windowClipTime=0.
final_pipeline_notes.android: whisper.cpp Base Q8; timestamps enabled for valid first-SOT no-speech probability.
final_pipeline_notes.qualification_limit: Host and simulator/emulator probes, not physical-device qualification. Small CoreML 217 MB variant was not run.

scope: Aggregate native comparison and final pipeline checks. Selected17speechcases,488normalizedwords; no audio/transcripts. Read note-asr-evaluation.md for corpus, raw-blank definition, tuning and physical-device limits.
